limitations: The top-down videos do not contain raw 4x84x84 observations, actions, or a receipt binding them to submission.zip, so the mechanism remains a code-consistent hypothesis.
The cap is deliberately current-detection-only. A one-frame obstacle detector miss can remove the cap and create longitudinal chatter; persisting it would be a separate unregistered change.
Post-registration acceptance clarifications were committed with implementation and therefore are not independently preregistered evidence.
No environment execution was allowed because required competition governance files are absent; finish-rate and Track 2 completion effects are unknown.
This result cannot support a causal, unseen-track, lap-time, submission, or SOTA claim.
